description: Fetch public OHLCV candles (open/high/low/close/volume, UTC bar times) — No api_key. USDT perpetual pairs. exchange is binance, bybit, or okx; symbol like BTCUSDT, one of get_available_pairs for that exchange (unlisted or malformed symbols are refused); timeframe is 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, or 1w (not interval). query_candles and calculate_indicator may require x402 USDC payment when enabled — invalid args are rejected before payment, and a tool error is never settled, so it costs nothing. US stocks and ETFs: exchange tiingo, symbol a ticker such as NVDA or BRK-B (find one by ticker or company name with get_available_pairs exchange tiingo + query), timeframe 5m, 15m, 1h, 1d, 1w, 1M, at most 500 split-adjusted bars, with attribution.
name: query_candles
title: Query Candles
